name: player_tick_local_player_controls
description: Player::TickLocalPlayerControls consumes local input into player state, updates reticle targeting, handles fire request latches, mode switch commands, and targeting-camera setup.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL/disassembly for 0x425a20 validates the local-control early return, joystick/mouse cursor ingestion, throttle/steering/sub vertical command mapping, cursor-zone steering and sub pitch calculations, signed input clamps, copy fields, HudUiMgr::UpdateTargetReticleFromCursor call, primary/alt fire request gates, alt trigger network warning side effect, mode-switch commands, and targeting-camera setup from stored target/camera target.

The native smoke drives the mouse-input lane with command bindings for throttle and alt trigger, verifies cursor-zone steering, sub pitch, clamped/copy fields, reset fire request latches, alt-trigger processing, and network timer warning side effect while exercising the HUD reticle update dependency.
tier S is deferred to a coherent player-control/source-cluster pass because this function is large, /Ob1-sensitive, and shares input/HUD/camera class context with adjacent player control code.
